posts.text:
My high school staged "The Diary of Anne Frank," and we were all kids, goofing around and laughing. 

The drama teacher came in the next day with a book of pictures from the Holocaust, threw it at us, and said: "THIS IS WHAT YOU'RE AFRAID OF."

and walked out

It changed us, and our performances.
posts.summary: Praises dramatic pedagogy confronting students with Holocaust reality
